data.body: Lane f041: closed through the completion-verifier gate (worktree fast-forwarded to merged main c0cf1022671). Gerrit 3052 patch set 3 (b1cc82b40f9a) had LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 (CI run 39272587679) and merged as c0cf1022671d088dcd0f7e74be2be41883cf5cbc. Before the close: file impact set to exactly the 72 files the merged diff touches; ACs reworded to what was verified. AC1 now says 11 removed spellings (16 parametrized rows with the 5 historical aliases). AC2's greps were re-run on merged main: 3 library-name rows, plus the two removed-set tests. AC10: tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json was deleted on main by 9415967b513 (MCP lane), so the AC now checks the merged diff touches no `_mcp_*.py` file and no `api_surface_baseline.json`, and that `gen_api_surface.py --check` and `gen_mcp_reference.py --check` pass. AC11 allows the 17 known pandoc failures. Re-review PASS (0 blocking, 5 advisory) at c0cf1022671; one advisory notes the title still says "twelve".
